name: STAR Orbit — relative motion near a circular orbit (Clohessy-Wiltshire) and two-impulse rendezvous
summary: Closed-form Clohessy-Wiltshire transition matrix, free drift and two-impulse rendezvous in the chief's rotating frame; algebra equal to the matrix exponential within 1.1e-13, departure from real two-body motion measured per separation, singular transfer times refused.
reference: Clohessy and Wiltshire, Terminal Guidance System for Satellite Rendezvous (1960): equations x'' - 2ny' - 3n^2 x = 0, y'' + 2nx' = 0, z'' + n^2 z = 0; textbook consequences: hold point on the along-track axis, 12 pi x0 drift per revolution for a radial offset, closed 2-by-1 ellipse
reference_observed: hold point unchanged to 1e-12; radial offset drift equal to 12 pi x0 within 1e-9; 2-by-1 ellipse closed after one and seven revolutions

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: any consistent length unit, seconds, rad/s; frame radial / along-track / normal stated in docstring and README
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for invalid input, overflow and singular transfer times; no iteration
